notes.title: Update: 12 Januar 2024 - Pizza Synthwave is now free
notes.notes:
Patch notes:
- Changed the game from original price of 4,99 to Free
- Added sound when the player speed climbs
- Fixed design on some levels
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Pizza Syntwhave: Update notes (May 16, 2023)
Day 2 Update
notes.notes:
Day 2 Update
Thanks to player feedback we fixed some issues.
This update includes:
- Bug fix for one the levels
- Various level improvements
- Better grapple hook visual effects
- New credits 

Enjoy! And thank you for the support!
